Class RestockController

java.lang.Object
manager.RestockController
public class RestockController extends Object

    • runRestockReport

      private String runRestockReport(List<String[]> transactionData, String restockLocation)
      Runs a Restock Report for All Locations, via looking at the Restock Location's Stock Amount. If it has stock, it is printed in the location's report.
      Parameters:
      transactionData - All the Order data for the Time Period
      restockLocation - The location that is the source of the restocks. If the location has 1 or more of an item, it will be exported for viewing.
      Returns:
      Returns the DataLength so other Reports don't need to redo calculation [helps a bit with runtime]

      dateLength - Given DateLength from the Restock Reports

    • prepareWorkbookDataForExport

      private void prepareWorkbookDataForExport(List<String[]> outputData, String fileName)
      Used to Prepare Data for Export for XLSX Files via the use of [org.apache.poi]. It changes the files into Workbooks.
      Parameters:
      outputData - The Data in the Format Needed for CSV Writer, needs to be organized.
      fileName - FileName for Output [has .xlsx taped on the end]
